preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(t, int) and t >= 1 and t <= 1000 for t in [int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(test_case) == 2 for test_case in [stdin.split()[1:].split() for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Each test case consists of exactly two lines: the first line is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000), and the second line contains 2n positive integers (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^6).

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(n), int) and n >= 1 and n <= 1000 for n in [int(stdin.split()[1:][0])])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after t is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000).

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == 2 * int(n) for a, n in zip([line.split() for line in stdin.split()[1:][1::2]], [int(stdin.split()[1:][0])]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains exactly 2n positive integers.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(a_i), int) and a_i >= 1 and a_i <= 10**6 for a_i in [int(a) for a in stdin.split()[1:][1::2][0]])
preconditions.description: Each element in the array a is a positive integer (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^6).

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in line or 'NO' in line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO', indicating whether it is possible to throw out all elements of the array.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in line and any('x' in line.lower() for line in stdout.splitlines()[i+1:i+1+n+1]) for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if line.strip() == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the second line contains the initial value of x chosen. The next n lines describe the operations, each line containing a pair of integers removed in that operation.

postconditions.expression: all('NO' in line and len(stdout.splitlines()[i+1:i+1+n+1]) == 0 for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()) if line.strip() == 'NO')
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'NO', no additional lines are printed for that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(a) + int(b) == int(x) for a, b in [line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n]] if line.strip() != '') for i, x in enumerate([line for line in stdout.splitlines() if 'YES' in line and 'x' in line.lower()]))
postconditions.description: For each operation in a 'YES' case, the sum of the two removed integers equals the current value of x (initially chosen and updated as the maximum of the two removed numbers).

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(a).intersection(set(b))) == 0 for a, b in [([int(num) for num in line.split()], [int(num) for num in a]) for line, a in zip(stdout.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n], [stdin.split()[1:][1::2][0]]) if line.strip() != ''] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), n+2))
postconditions.description: Each pair of integers removed in an operation is distinct and does not overlap with previously removed pairs in the same test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(a) in [int(num) for num in a_list] and int(b) in [int(num) for num in a_list] for a, b in [line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+n]]) for i, a_list in enumerate([stdin.split()[1:][1::2][0] for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: Each pair of integers removed in an operation exists in the current array at the time of removal.
